vocabulary.meaning_en: a word that points to something: this, that, these, those
one thing that is far (there), or finished in time
vocabulary.note_ar: تذكّر: حرف a في that = away (بعيد)
vocabulary.example: That is his car over there.

vocabulary.meaning_en: more than one thing that is near
more than one thing that is far, or finished in time

vocabulary.example: The airport is far from here.

vocabulary.meaning_en: how near or far something is compared to something else
at a distance from a place or person
vocabulary.example: He moved the book away from me.

vocabulary.meaning_en: be used alone, without a noun after it
vocabulary.example: In "Did you like that?", "that" stands by itself.

vocabulary.meaning_en: at a time in the past that is finished
vocabulary.example: In those days, people wrote letters by hand.
At this time, I want to start the quiz.

vocabulary.meaning_en: be the same or go well together
vocabulary.example: The demonstrative must match the noun: these shoes.

fine_lines.title: this vs that
fine_lines.explanation_ar: this لشيء قريب منك (هنا)، و that لشيء بعيد عنك (هناك). تذكّر أن a في that تعني away أي بعيد.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "This" is for something near you (here). "That" is for something far (there). Remember: the "a" in "that" means away.

examples.sentence: I like this book in my hand.
Can I see that coat over there?

fine_lines.title: this vs these
fine_lines.explanation_ar: this للمفرد وتنتهي بصوت s خفيف. these للجمع وتنتهي بصوت z مع ياء طويلة.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "This" is singular with a soft /s/ sound. "These" is plural with a long "ee" and a /z/ sound.

fine_lines.title: demonstrative pronoun vs demonstrative adjective
fine_lines.explanation_ar: الضمير يقف وحده ويأتي بعده فعل غالبًا: This is my car. الصفة تأتي قبل اسم لتحدده: This car is mine.
fine_lines.explanation_en: As a pronoun it stands alone, often before a verb: "This is my car." As an adjective it goes before a noun: "This car is mine."

expressions.meaning_en: Did you enjoy what just happened?
expressions.example: We watched the match. Did you like that?

expressions.phrase: Can I see that coat over there?
expressions.meaning_ar: هل يمكنني رؤية ذلك المعطف هناك؟
expressions.meaning_en: A polite request in a shop for something far from you.
expressions.example: Excuse me, can I see that coat over there?

expressions.meaning_en: at the same time, one day from now
expressions.example: Can you meet me at this time tomorrow?

expressions.phrase: What are these shoes doing in here?
expressions.meaning_ar: ما الذي تفعله هذه الأحذية هنا؟
expressions.meaning_en: Why are these shoes in this place?
expressions.example: What are these shoes doing in the kitchen?

grammar.title: Near and far: this/these vs that/those
grammar.explanation_ar: للقريب: this (مفرد) و these (جمع). للبعيد: that (مفرد) و those (جمع). المسافة نسبية: الشيء الأقرب this والأبعد that.
grammar.explanation_en: Near: this (one), these (more than one). Far: that (one), those (more than one). The distance is relative: the closer thing is "this", the farther one is "that".
examples: This pen is mine. That pen is yours.
These shoes are new. Those shoes are old.

grammar.title: Demonstrative pronouns
grammar.explanation_ar: عندما يقف اسم الإشارة وحده بدون اسم بعده فهو ضمير، ويأتي غالبًا قبل الفعل: This is my car. Those are old cars. وقد يأتي في آخر الجملة: Did you like that?
grammar.explanation_en: When the demonstrative stands alone (no noun after it), it is a pronoun. It often comes before a verb: "This is my car." "Those are old cars." It can also end a sentence: "Did you like that?"

grammar.title: Demonstrative adjectives
grammar.explanation_ar: ضع this/that/these/those قبل الاسم لتحدد أي شيء تقصد: this cup, that book, these shoes, those cars.
grammar.explanation_en: Put this/that/these/those before a noun to show which one: this cup, that book, these shoes, those cars.

grammar.title: Demonstratives for time
grammar.explanation_ar: نستعمل this/these للوقت القريب أو الحاضر: at this time, these days. ونستعمل that/those للوقت المنتهي في الماضي: in those days, at that time.
grammar.explanation_en: Use this/these for time that is now or close: at this time, these days. Use that/those for finished time in the past: in those days, at that time.
examples: At this time, I want to start the quiz.
In those days, there were no phones.

grammar.title: Match the noun and the verb
grammar.explanation_ar: يجب أن يتوافق اسم الإشارة مع الاسم والفعل: these shoes are (جمع)، this shoe is (مفرد). لا تقل: this shoes are.
grammar.explanation_en: The demonstrative must match the noun and the verb: "these shoes are" (plural), "this shoe is" (singular). Not "this shoes are".
examples: What are these shoes doing here?

questions.question: The book is in my hand. "I like ___ book."
questions.explanation_en: The book is near and singular: this.

questions.question: "What are ___ shoes doing in here?"
questions.explanation_en: Shoes are plural and near (here): these.

questions.question: In "This is my car", "this" is a demonstrative ___.
questions.explanation_ar: this تقف وحدها قبل الفعل is، فهي ضمير.
questions.explanation_en: "This" stands alone before the verb, so it is a pronoun.

questions.question: "In ___ days, people didn't have phones." (a finished past time)
questions.explanation_ar: للزمن الماضي المنتهي نستعمل in those days.
questions.explanation_en: For finished past time we say "in those days".

questions.question: Which word ends with a /z/ sound?
questions.explanation_ar: those تنتهي بصوت z مثل these.

questions.question: "Can you meet me at ___ time tomorrow?" (close to now)
questions.explanation_ar: الوقت قريب من الآن ومفرد: this time.
questions.explanation_en: The time is close to now and singular: this time.

questions.question: What does "demonstrative" mean here?
choices: a word that points to something
questions.explanation_ar: اسم الإشارة كلمة تشير إلى شيء.
questions.explanation_en: A demonstrative is a word that points to something.
